title: Handling of network rejection due to ESM cause #26

entities.name: Insufficient resources
entities.description: ESM cause value #26 indicating insufficient network resources for the requested operation.

entities.name: Back-off timer value IE
entities.description: Information element carrying the timer value for T3396 timer in network rejection scenarios.

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator IE
entities.description: Information element indicating re-attempt conditions, ignored when Back-off timer value IE is present with ESM cause #26.

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: Timer used to enforce back-off period after network rejection with insufficient resources.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message used by UE to request PDN connectivity, restricted during T3396 running.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message used by UE to modify bearer resources, restricted during T3396 running.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message used by UE to allocate bearer resources, restricted during T3396 running.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management state where UE is not registered with the network.

entities.name: Timer value neither zero nor deactivated
entities.description: Condition where Back-off timer value IE contains a non-zero, non-deactivated timer value.

entities.name: Timer value deactivated
entities.description: Condition where Back-off timer value IE indicates timer deactivation.

entities.name: Timer value zero
entities.description: Condition where Back-off timer value IE contains a zero timer value.

entities.name: No request messages during T3396
entities.description: UE shall not send PDN connectivity or bearer resource request messages while T3396 is running.

relations.description: ESM cause #26 triggers evaluation of Back-off timer value IE presence and value.
Presence of Back-off timer value IE causes UE to ignore Re-attempt indicator IE.
Non-zero timer value condition starts T3396 with provided value.
Non-zero timer value condition stops T3396 if running before starting.
Non-zero timer value condition establishes restriction on sending request messages.
Deactivated timer value condition establishes indefinite restriction on sending request messages.
Zero timer value condition stops T3396 if running.
T3396 continues running when UE enters EMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Message restriction property prevents sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST.
Message restriction property prevents sending BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST.
Message restriction property prevents sending BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST.
